note: Recommendations for current evidence collection, not a test pass or canonical acceptance. User log requirement L01 is supplementary to the plan rows.

cases.title: Owned and inactive package
cases.check: Inspect the exact proposed source manifest, neutral configuration, charter/role pairs, owner interfaces, active Template mappings and generated role navigation. Bind all results to the candidate hash. Verify one source owner per destination, inactive defaults and preserved generic Director behavior.

cases.title: Fresh setup and historical editions
cases.check: Run the real proposed initializer against disposable fresh and existing projects. Select Curator adoption explicitly for the existing project; reopen receipts and emitted assets. Preserve original base editions, licenses, custom content, capture preferences and record identity. Repeat the same completed request and confirm it does not silently refresh to a new edition.

cases.title: Owned entry and repair
cases.check: Exercise a selected ordinary correction through the actual Application and supported public owners. Confirm one selected controller, actual manager receipt/activation and one canonical Task; queue state only references it. Preserve existing category/team rules. A repeated request reconnects the same operation. Prove an isolated simple repair keeps interfaces and unrelated/staged user edits.

cases.title: Durable event flow
cases.check: Use disposable repositories and actual collector/queue/checkpoint entry points. Cover missed, duplicate and reordered delivery; branch changes, rename/deletion and rewritten history. Restart before delivery to demonstrate durable correction/cursors. Verify one logical outcome, source-bound obligations and necessary derivative follow-through without restarting a satisfied repair.

cases.title: No-op and bounded inspection
cases.check: Run actual status/review/intake/metric reads with no relevant work and with an irrelevant event. Compare content and canonical state before/after; count model invocations explicitly. Require zero inference, Tasks, knowledge records and content rewrites for no relevant work. Missing data must remain distinguishable from an observed zero.

cases.title: Integration and exact recovery
cases.check: Exercise the real application integration/recovery path in disposable projects. Recheck candidate and source snapshots, preserve later edits, and coordinate existing owners. Pause or interrupt at an ordinary recorded partial boundary, restart and retry the original operation. Inspect real pre/post state and receipts, then verify required product versions before reconciliation.

cases.title: Owned knowledge and products
cases.check: Call supported memory/ontology owners in isolated fixtures for neither/either/both knowledge decisions and derived-only maintenance. Reopen current/history records, identity relations and selected product receipts. Capture-off must prevent automatic persistence; an explicit correction keeps its separate authority. A failed required product remains pending and an unsupported meaning remains held with its exact evidence gap.

cases.title: Documentation and learning
cases.check: Exercise representative rename, changed-interface and policy-change inputs with distinct source owners. Verify README/descriptive edits, generated regeneration, stable historical reports and unknown/mixed ownership handling. Trace a finding through one supported learning disposition, repair or bounded investigation and current evidence; already-fixed work receives only remaining obligations.

cases.title: Dependency compatibility
cases.check: Use a selected due release/compatibility observation with source, timestamp and version. Demonstrate compatibility against actual supported owner interfaces before changing a reference or pin. Exercise an isolated proposed dependency declaration and affected-product checks; record installation authority separately and leave the real environment unchanged.

cases.title: Portable scheduling and measures
cases.check: Use disposable host-adapter inputs for idle, pending, unavailable, blocked and ready; require current runtime observations for ready. Verify selected budgets/cadences, detached input retention and relocation identity. Count duplicates, reversals, repeated failures, staleness, elapsed reconciliation and idle inference with attributable records. Distribution must not install hooks or a service.

cases.title: Conversation and original intent
cases.check: Run actual offer/selection/handoff/resume integration. Cover unrelated silence, information/warning/blocking impact, one clear do-it offer, multiple/stale offers and a read-only question. Preserve original objective/constraints/Task. After completed and blocked maintenance, recheck current assumptions before permitted continuation; never create duplicate execution.

cases.title: Proposed package to final release
cases.check: First pass connected retained behavior and fresh/adopted setup using the exact complete proposed package. Then review check/apply/check for source-to-Template publication. Reopen all mapped outputs and verify ownership, missing-input handling and exact interrupted updater recovery in disposable tests. Compare protected root/product baselines, selected source manifest, registry and final canonical acceptance. No production rollout or operational benefit claim follows from this source release.

cases.title: Summary-first logs and bounded queries
cases.check: Create a log larger than 2,000,000 bytes with known notable components and events. Inspect the actual outgoing agent payload: it must contain a bounded summary and durable log reference/query instructions, never the complete log. Exercise search/filter/range/pagination as supported by the real public query API and verify selected details, stable source locators and bounded output. Include late notable events, repeated lines, no matches and truncated long entries; demonstrate useful highlights and on-demand retrieval without changing the source log.
